On one hand, family obligations often include attending funerals as a sign of respect and support. On the other hand, if I don't know the person and don't feel connected to them, is it wrong to not attend? I should consider the feelings of my mom and the rest of the family. They might feel hurt or disrespected if I don't attend. But I also have to think about my own feelings and comfort. Funerals can be emotionally draining, especially if I don't feel a connection to the person. Maybe there's a middle ground. It's also worth considering the potential consequences of not attending. Could it strain my relationship with my mom or other family members?
